description: Hand-painted flowers, birds and pots by Calico Melton, a painter in Bristol. Giclée prints of her paintings, to buy online.
heroLine: Making joyful art for your home
introHeading: Hello, I'm Calico! I love to create joyful art for your walls, from decorative narrative based pieces to abstract that gives you a moment of visual meditation, I hand paint it all in Bristol. Using layers of texture and a considered colour palette to bring a moment of joy to your walls.
introText:
I paint in a small studio in Bristol: flowers, birds, and the pots and vases they live in.

My prints are scanned gstraight from the original paintings, with no digital retouching, then printed on beautiful 300gsm prestige paper.
